Commentary.Commentary: With that, we come to the end of our coverage of this game. Sri Lanka competed initially but didn't have the quality to stretch South Africa deep. Let's hope the visitors can show better fight in the next Test that begins in Cape Town on 2nd January 2017 from 1330 IST onwards. Do join us for that one. Cheers and have a great New Year weekend!

STEPHEN COOK (MAN OF THE MATCH) feels it's good to return to form and says that he wants to capitalize as much as possible on this purple patch. Says that he sticks to his work ethics every day regardless of whether South Africa are batting or not. Hopes to keep his form going forward.

FAF DU PLESSIS feels that it's been a good Test to end the year. Says that they had to work hard especially in the first few days. Credits his team for the good effort. States that 2016 has been great in the last six months for them. Feels that it was good to start well on a green surface and although they were 50 runs lesser than they wanted, opines that the bowlers were very good. Feels that the 81-run lead was big for such a total. Says that he knew it would be more difficult to get wickets in the second innings. Credits the bowlers for stepping up, especially the pacers and also lauds Maharaj's knack of showing good support. Hopes his side can maintain the consistency and keep going strong.

ANGELO MATHEWS feels that the bowling was good but they didn't quite bat well in the first innings. Feels that the pitch was tough in the first two days and then eased on. Laments poor shot selection as a reason for their loss. Admits that they fought back well but adds that they should have shown it from the start of the game. Feels that the short break between matches isn't a matter, stresses on the mindset factor. Hopes that his team can better their team and individual performances in the next Test.

With a lead of 487, du Plessis declared rather early on day four and it was always going to be a big ask for the Lankans. They had a good opening stand but once it was broken due to a bizarre run out, they lost the plot. Some poor shots coupled with excellent bowling saw the visitors five down by stumps and from there, it was going to be a superhuman challenge for them. Thoroughly professional performance by the Proteas.

Mathews, Chandimal and de Silva minimized the damage but an 81-run lead was always going to be massive on such a pitch. Philander with a fifer and Abbott with a 3-fer did bulk of the damage for the hosts. South Africa then drove home the advantage with a fantastic batting performance on day three. Cook followed his first innings fifty with a century while Elgar, Faf and de Kock all struck fifties too.

After opting to bat, a good opening partnership along with a Duminy fifty had set the platform for the Proteas as they were 213-3 at one stage. However, on a pitch with enough movement for the pacers, Lakmal's fifer brought the Lankans back in the game as the last 7 SA wickets fell for just 73 runs to give the visitors a chance. However, poor batting let them down as nobody really went on to get a big score.

Emphatic win for the Proteas and they go 1-0 up in the 3-match Test series. It was always going to be an uphill task this morning with a lot riding on Mathews and de Silva. Both departed quite early to Abbott and it was a mere formality after that as the hosts sealed the game just after the drinks break. Rabada and Maharaj took three wickets apiece in the innings while Abbott made the big breakthroughs today. It was a promising start to the game for the Lankans though as they competed well in the first two days.

Almost! This is what I was talking about. Another full and straight ball from Philander, Lakmal cannot keep the flick down and luckily for him, it falls between forward short leg and short mid-wicket.

Gets a leading edge that goes to the left of the bowler. Philander reacts sharply by sticking out his left hand and takes a fine tumbling return catch. Looked awkward when he landed but he seems to be fine. The procession continues for the Lankans. SA just two away now.
Good bowling! Length ball just outside off, draws Chameera forward and the ball flies past the outside edge.
Short ball this time and Chameera ducks under it.
Good length closer to off, blocked firmly by Chameera by getting right behind the line.

So both important overnight batsmen back in the hut inside the first hour. SA are into the Lankan tail now. Just 3 wickets away.
Abbott has trapped de Silva lbw. Looked really close. De Silva is the last specialist batsman out there, so he rightfully decides to review it. Was it a bit high?
That looked awkward but effective eventually. Short ball angled into Herath who plays an unconvincing pull past backward square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Herath gets right behind it and blocks it well.

Full and outside off, de Silva leans forward to push at it with soft hands and an angled bat. The ball goes off the outer half past a diving gully fielder towards third man. Cook gives a long chase and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
Short ball outside off, Herath swivels and pulls it well. Straight towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, punched solidly off the back foot.
Length ball on off, tails in a bit as Herath looks to play around his front pad. Gets a hit on his glove again. His fingers are getting a work over at the moment.
Beaten again! Back of a length angled in from outside off, once again Herath misses the poke.
Play and a miss! Good length angled in from outside off, holds its line to whiz past the outside edge.
Another short ball and this time de Silva goes after it with a pull but misses.

Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks it firmly.
Good length outside off, jags in a bit as de Silva blocks well.

FOUR! Good shot! Fuller outside off, de Silva gets forward and punches it serenly past the bowler down the ground. Mid off is a bit wider and this goes away to the fence. Offered the full face of the bat and it was a pleasing shot.

Short ball and this time Herath goes for the pull. Mistimes it aerially over mid-wicket. Falls safe and they get a single.
Dug in short closer to off, de Silva sways away from the line.
Back of a length outside off, worked off the back foot through mid-wicket for a brace. Nice use of the wrists there.
Short of a length outside off, blocked firmly off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller ball outside off, a big stride forward and pats it towards cover.
Full and outside off, leans forward and defends it firmly.
Good length outside off, gets back to that one and jabs it towards point.
Short of a length around off, Herath looks to block but the ball goes off the outside edge to gully on the bounce. He's certainly a bit nervy out there.
The medical staff is out to attend to Herath. It's his bowling finger too, so the tourists will be concerned. Finally, he seems ready to go. Good news for the Lankans.
OUCH! What a welcome for Herath! Back of a length ball angled in from outside off, rises off the deck as he looks to fend it awkwardly. Raps him flush on the glove as he drops his left hand in pain.

Umpire's call and so the on-field call will stay. A decent innings from the skipper comes to an end but he knows it was a false stroke.
Mathews has been given out lbw. Looked quite plumb but he decides to review it after a chat with de Silva. Probably a gamble.

Fuller and closer to off, solid defence from the Lankan captain.
Length ball on the pads, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Good length closer to off, de Silva defends solidly from the crease.
VERNON PHILANDER to bowl from the other end.

Fuller on middle, leans across and drives it to mid on.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Crucial session this for the tourists with the second new ball still fresh. KYLE ABBOTT to start the proceedings on day 5. Two slips and a gully in place.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the final day's play. Another 248 runs are required for the Lankans to pull off an improbable victory. The realistic possibility is of Proteas needing five more wickets to win. The current partnership will decide if the Lankans stay alive in the day as an early strike could trigger a collapse. A wicketless first session might make things interesting in the run chase. The action isn't far away.
.....DAY 5, SESSION 1.....

The first session of every morning has been producing wickets in this match, apart from today. Will Sri Lanka be able to weather the storm and take the game deep? Or will the Saffas bowl them out quickly? Join us at 1330 IST (0800 GMT) for all the action from Day 5. In the meanwhile, you can also have a look at all the action from the Australia-Pakistan Test in Melbourne. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

98 overs to be bowled tomorrow. 5 wickets needed for South Africa. 248 runs required for Sri Lanka. Normal mathematics will tell you either is possible. But practical assessment will tell you that the Proteas are just a wicket away from getting into the tail and wrapping it up.
Everyone toiled hard with Rabada and Maharaj getting 2 wickets apiece. The fielders did not quite support their bowlers else the Proteas would not have had to do so much effort.

Karunaratne and Kaushal Silva played the new ball bowlers very well. They frustrated them and then took their stand to 87 before a mini-collapse occurred, reducing them to 118/3. Mathews and Mendis then had a quickfire 75-run stand before the latter, then Chandimal, played poor shots to bring the Proteas back into the game.

The Proteas did not waste much time this morning, declaring immediately after de Kock's dismissal. They gave themselves 85 allotted overs to bowl at the Lankans today and would have expected plenty of wickets. However, they had to work hard.

Excellent day for Sri Lanka. Yes, they are 5 down and are staring down the barrel in terms of saving the Test, but at least they have shown some fight. It would have been a wonderful day had Chandimal and Mendis not thrown their wickets away.

The ball races to the ropes but Keshav Maharaj gives it a good chase from deep square leg and gets to the ball. Dives first, parries the ball away, but it rolls back in. He is careful not to touch it as he is in contact with the ropes. Dives out, pushes the ball away and then falls down. Two runs taken. Brilliant presence of mind.

Landed around off, punched straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! On the pads, flicked easily through mid-wicket for a boundary. Don't want to be missing such gifts.
On middle and off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
A short ball around off, Kusal rises with the bounce and keeps it down.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
Down the leg side, tickled straight to backward square leg.
On a length around off, turned towards mid-wicket for a couple.
VERNON PHILANDER returns.
Full and around off, watchfully kept out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
50-run stand is up in just 56 balls!
FOUR! Nicely played. Fractionally short around off, Mathews uses his wrists and works it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

NOT OUT. It was the arm ball, around off, skidded on, beating Mathews on his flick. He was hit on the pads and Maharaj and de Kock immediately went up on the appeal but umpire Oxenford shook his head. Maharaj intially did not look too keen on the review but Faf du Plessis asked someone and then went for the review. Hawk Eye showed the ball to be missing leg.
Review taken by South Africa. Maharaj reckons he has Mathews trapped LBW in front, albeit not convincingly. Faf du Plessis is happy to take the half-chance.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! The runs are flowing now. Full and outside off, Mathews drives it straight down the ground and beats mid off comfortably for the third boundary of the over!
Full and around off, Angelo looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge through square leg. A single taken.
FOUR! More runs. A short ball outside off, Mathews places it nicely behind point and gets another boundary.
FOUR! A full toss on the pads, Mathews flicks it away with ease through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. Mendis wants the third but is sent back.

FOUR! Wasn't in total control but got it into the gap. Short and outside off, Mendis rocked back and looked to cut. The ball flew off the top edge but well wide of the man at point, over covers for a boundary. 150 UP FOR SRI LANKA.
Landed around middle, spinning away, squares Mendis up who somehow pushes it to the off side.
Comes down the track and drives it to deepish mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
FOUR! THRASH! Full on middle, Mathews charges down the track and blasts it past the bowler down to long on for a boundary.
The batsman does well to stand tall and play that short delivery.

FOUR! Uppish but wide. Short and wide outside off, Mendis opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point, aerially. The fielder from backward point dives to his right but cannot get to the ball. Into the fence she goes.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single. Leg bye signalled.
Landed around off, defended from the crease.
Outside off, left alone.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.

MISFIELD! FOUR! Too many of those today. Full and on middle, Mendis gets down and sweeps it through square leg. It is straight to Stephen Cook over there who gets down but lets it right through his legs. Gateway of India or Sydney Harbour Bridge. Or any other which might be in South Africa.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, Mendis looks to defend and then tries to take his bat away but is beaten.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They manage to come back for the second.
A short ball outside off, Mendis rises to fend but the ball goes off the outside edge wide of slip to third man. A single taken.
A bouncer now, Kusal ducks.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Landed around middle and off, defended from the crease.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, well kept out.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! FABULOUS! Full and outside off, Mendis leans and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary!
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh-pad. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg bye signalled by the umpire.
A short ball around off, Mathews sways away from the line.
On middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed beautifully but straight to short cover.
Landed around off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Oohhh... that came off the edge. Full and outside off, Mendis looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge, wide of first slip towards third man. A single taken.
Full and around off, watchfully kept out.
Comes down the track, has a hack and luckily for him, does not time it well. The ball does not carry to mid on.
Landed around off, defended from the crease.
Outside off, placed behind point for a single.
On middle and off, Mendis works it towards mid-wicket. Mathews wants a single but Mendis clearly shouts, "NO! NO!"
On a good length around off, defended watchfully.
A short leg comes in place now.
Full and just around off, flicked wide of mid on. Kyle Abbott puts in the hard yards after it and manages to stop it near the ropes. Three runs taken.
ANGELO MATHEWS walks in at number 5, replacing Silva.

OUT! LBW! Rabada strikes immediately on return! On a good length outside off, nipping back in, Silva looks to defend but misses the line and is hit on the pads. Rabada appeals, umpire Aleem Dar takes his time and then raises his finger! Silva has a chat with Mendis and then takes the review. Replays do not detect any inside edge and Hawk Eye shows that to be hitting leg stump, in spite of the ball hitting him on the knee roll. End of a watchful and patient knock.
Silva has been adjudged LBW! He has taken the review though.
Full and down the leg side, Silva misses his flick.
KAGISO RABADA is back on.
Full and outside off, pushed towards extra cover.
Landed outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Full and around middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Half volley outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full and outside off, driven waste of mid off.

Welcome back for the final session of day 4. Mendis and Silva calmed things down after losing 2 quick wickets. They will have to stay strong in the middle and the middle order batsmen to follow also have to step up if they want to save this match. South Africa will look to come up and running after the break and look to scalp some quick wickets. KESHAV MAHARAJ will begin the proceedings for this session!
... DAY 4, SESSION 3 ...

Keshav Maharaj was the pick of the bowlers for the hosts as he troubled the Lankan batsmen the most with the amount of turn he purchased from the surface. The quickies were trying their hearts out but the visitors played them well and didn't offer any loose shots. South Africa need 8 wickets more to win while Silva and Mendis still look to fight it out for their team in the middle. Let's see what the third session has in bag for us when we return shortly with it.

From 27/0 to 118/2 is what we witnessed in the session. Sri Lanka's openers continued their gritty innings and started frustrating the African bowlers as they saw off another hour after Lunch safely. However, luck was what South Africa needed and they got it when Karunaratne stumbled while going for a run and got run out! This boosted the confidence of the hosts as they soon got rid of Kusal Perera!
Pitched up around off, driven straight back. Abbott fields it and hurls a friendly underarm throw at the striker's end to end things off of the second session as it's TEA ON DAY 4!
Full outside off, driven on the up to mid off.
Short delivery, surprises Silva who plays an uncontrolled pull towards mid-wicket and runs through for a couple.
Angling into the batsman, Silva looks to defend it from within the crease but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Full on middle and off, Mendis clips it superbly through front of square on the leg side and gets three runs for it.

FOUR! Shortish delivery outside off, turning away, Silva presses forward initially but then adjusts his shot seeing the length. However, ends up top edging it over Amla at first slip and through to the third man fence.
Tossed up outside off, driven through mid off. This time it's the skipper who is sloppy in his field and gives away a single.
Silva leans ahead in defence but the ball spins away after landing, catches the outside edge and goes past Amla at first slip. The batsmen take a single!
Shortish delivery, KM goes back and cuts through covers. Duminy, present there, makes a half stop which allows the batsmen run through for a single.
Outside off, spinning away, Mendis once again looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten by the away turn.
Served outside off, spinning away, Mendis prods forward in defence but gets an outside edge into the ground and towards first slip.
There is a slight delay in starting the over as Maharaj is having a conversation with his skipper. Might be about a ploy against Kusal Mendis!
Outside off, Silva lets it go through!
On a length outside off, Silva stays in his crease and defends it with a straight bat.
Pitched outside off, Silva presses forward in defence.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
A touch fuller outside off, angling in, defended with a straight bat.
Landed around off, Kusal prods forward and blocks it.
Served fuller outside off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Swept away uppishly! Tossed up on the stumps, Mendis kneels down and sweeps over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shortish delivery, going on with the angle. Mendis goes back and cuts it into the ground and towards covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sloppy from Duminy! Full outside off, driven through covers. Duminy present there misfields and gives away a couple.
Another bouncer! Silva ducks under it once again!
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Outside off, pushed to covers.

NOT OUT! Full outside off, driven straight back. Abbott gets a hand to it and deflects it onto the stumps. Mendis who is out of his crease, turns back immediately and dives back in. The players appeal and the onfield umpire refers it upstairs. The replays confirm that Abbott has got hand to it however Mendis has made his ground before the ball hit the stumps.
A run out decision against Mendis is referred upstairs.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Straighter one, landed outside off, Mendis goes back and defends it on the off side.
Around off, KM prods forward in defence.

FOUR! Swept away! Low full toss, Mendis gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Aleem Dar, the leg umpire jumps as the ball goes through his legs towards the fence! The slow motion replay makes it a little comical!
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Mendis clears his front leg and drives it back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, nips back in a touch, Silva looks to defend it from within the crease but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery angling in, Mendis shuffles across and plays it late behind square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length delivery angling in, defended from within the crease with a straight bat.
Mendis makes another leave to the outside off delivery.
Pitched outside off, left alone.
Served fuller on the stumps, defended off the front foot with the full face of his bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

A mild appeal! Served outside off, Silva comes out of his crease once again and plays it towards covers. There are two noises and the fielding side starts appealing but the umpire turns it down. The replay shows that the ball brushes the pad on its way and then comes off the bat towards covers. However, the impact was outside off!
Silva charges down and blocks the ball on the bounce.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Served fuller outside off, spinning away a touch, Silva prods forward in defence but is beaten by the turn. It goes off the outer half of the bat and just wide of first slip.
Change of ends for KESHAV MAHARAJ.
Fullish outside off, angling in, defended with a straight bat.
Length delivery angling in, defended from within the crease.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Pitched on a length outside off, defended from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery outside off, nips back in sharply, Mendis gets on his toes and defends it into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
KYLE ABBOTT is back on!
Full outside off, driven on the up to mid off.
Once again Silva is beaten as the ball swings away after pitching.
BEATEN! Full outside off, Silva drives but gets beaten as he is late into it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in next!

OUT! Maharaj strikes! Short outside off, Perera looks to cut it but once again fails to get it off the middle of the bat as the ball bounces a touch higher, catches the outside edge of the bat and de Kock behind the stumps takes a sharp reflex catch. Perera's short stint is over. Can this open the floodgates? Sri Lanka still a long way behind. SOUTH AFRICA NEED 8 WICKETS MORE TO WIN!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid off.
Short outside off, Perera looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge into the ground and towards first slip.
FOUR! Spinning down leg, tickled round the corner for a boundary through fine leg.

Appeal for LBW! Served outside off, spinning in sharply, surprises Perera, who gets beaten by the turn and is hit on the pads. De Kock and Maharaj appeal but is turned down by Aleem Dar. The replay shows it was spinning too much and also was high.
Full on middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Length delivery angling in, defended from within the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, defended to point.
Spinning into the pads, flicked away on the leg side for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
KUSAL PERERA walks in at no. 3!

OUT!  Run out! What have you done, Karunaratne! Tossed up around middle and off, Silva uses his feet and carves it through covers. There's some confusion in the middle as Karunaratne calls Silva for a single but stumbles after taking off. However, he runs through in the end. Duminy is the man present at covers. He gets to the ball in a flash, collects it and throws in a single motion. It's a good throw as it goes straight in the gloves of de Kock, who takes the bails off in a flash. They chose the wrong man to take on! That's the worst way possible to lose a wicket in a Test match and especially when you want to save the match!
The square leg umpire has referred it upstairs for a run out appeal against Karunaratne!
Once again Karunaratne uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it down to long on for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, DK waits for it to turn into him and then cuts through covers for a brace.
Karunaratne gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it on the bounce towards mid-wicket.
Full and angling in, played with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Similar delivery, similar shot but an even better result! Once again Karunaratne shuffles across and Philander gets his line wrong as he angles it down leg, tucked through backward square leg for a boundary.
Angling into the pads, Karunaratne shuffles and tucks it through square leg for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, angling in, Dimuth covers his stumps and makes the leave.
VERNON PHILANDER is into the attack now!
This time Karunaratne finds the gap on the leg side as he flicks it with the turn and take a single.
Spinning down leg, Dimuth camps back and works it with the spin to leg gully.
Once again, DK plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Spinning into the pads, worked with the spin to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Karunaratne brings out the reverse sweep! Fuller on the stumps, Karunaratne reverse sweeps through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Dimuth looks to defend it off the front foot but gets off the inner edge of the bat into the ground and towards leg gully.
DRINKS BREAK! Sri Lanka have seen through another hour of play without losing any wickets. South Africa should now worry about the partnership and should be on the attack!
Length delivery outside off, Silva remains composed in defence.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! Length delivery outside off, punched from within the crease through covers for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, left alone.
Length delivery on the stumps, driven straight back. The batsmen take three runs.
A bouncer, Karunaratne ducks.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Landed on middle and leg, spinning away, Silva looks to sweep it trying to play it with the angle but the away turn beats him and the ball goes from the behind of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on the stumps, Silva gets ahead and pushes it to covers.
Silva once again uses his feet and plays it towards mid on.
Outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.
Again a wide delivery, Dimuth looks to cut it but misses it this time.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten! Length delivery outside off, DK looks to defend it from within the crease but gets beaten as the ball straightens a bit.
FOUR! Shortish delivery wide outside off, Karunaratne looks to slap it but gets off the toe end through covers and to the fence. Rabada should be bowling closer to the stumps.
Full and angling in, defended solidly.
On middle and leg, Silva gets out of his crease and carves it towards covers.

Beautiful delivery! Tossed up nicely outside off, Silva looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten by the ball spinning away. De Kock behind the stumps collects it cleanly and removes the bails off but there is no appeal as Silva never left his crease.
Karunaratne again uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives through mid on for a single.
DK gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it on the bounce.
Dimuth stays in the crease and defends it late.
Defended with the turn to square leg.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone.
4 Byes! Wayward delivery! Tries a yorker but gets it wrong completely. Pitches it wide down the leg side. De Kock also fails to stop it and the ball runs away to the fine leg fence.
Length delivery outside off, Silva covers his stumps and lets it go through.
OUCH! That must have surely hurt! Banged in short, angling in, Silva gets his eyes off the ball and ducks. The ball doesn't bounce as much as he expects and gets hit on the rib cage.
Outside off, left alone.
Karunaratne gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it near the surface!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and leg, played through mid-wicket for a couple.

DROPPED! On middle and leg, Silva gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it over mid-wicket. Elgar at short mid-wicket gets to his right, jumps full stretch, gets hand to it but fails to grab it. The ball then rolls down to mid on and the batsmen run through for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple. This also brings the 50-run stand for the opening wicket!
Banged in short, Karunaratne ducks under it!
On middle and off and angling in, played into the ground and towards short leg.
Angling down leg, DK looks to work it but misses.
Angling into the pads, flicked on the leg side.
Length delivery angling in, defended with a straight bat.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
Change of ends for KAGISO RABADA!
Served on off, defended to mid on.

Flighted around off, spinning in, Karunaratne gets a long way across and looks to sweep it but doesn't connect. Is lucky to have got some glove on it else he would have been dead plumb. The ball then runs towards fine leg. Three runs taken! Good running!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Served fuller outside off, DK leans ahead and blocks it.
Spinning into the southpaw, defended with the turn to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, defended by proding forward on the leg side.
Bowling change as KESHAV MAHARAJ is introduced! A backward short leg is in place for him!
FOUR! On the hips, Silva gets across and works it fine behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Angling into the batsman, defended with a straight bat off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, defended from within the crease.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Nice shot. Driven down the ground but Duminy at silly mid on dives to his right and parries it to mid on.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off, DK presses forward in defence but gets beaten as the ball whizzes past the outside edge with a hint of away movement.
Outside off, left alone.
Angling into Karunaratne, punched off the back foot to mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.

Low full toss outside off, Dimuth looks to drive but gets a bottom edge into the ground and towards second slip. Faf, who is present there takes eyes of the ball and gets hit on the shin. That must have hurt!
KAGISO RABADA has been brought on.
Pitched outside off, Silva remains solid in defence.

FOUR! Guided through! Length delivery outside off, Silva leans ahead and guides it towards the third man region. Elgar from the slip codon gives it a chase but as he dives to save the boundary, his body crosses the fence when in contact with the ball. Bavuma running along with him signals four to the umpire.
This time Silva defends solidly by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

A mild appeal! Length delivery outside off, nips back in, Kaushal shuffles across and presses ahead to defend but gets beaten by the inward movement. Gets hit high on the pads. The fielding side appeal but the umpire shakes his head in denial. The replay shows that the impact was outside off and also was high.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pitched outside off, angles in but after getting past the stumps. Silva leaves it in his typical style.
So that fielding move was a double bluff as once again he pitches it full outside off, defended with a straight bat.
He bowls it fuller around off, defended solidly to covers.
Maharaj has been moved to deep square leg. Short ball might be around the corner!
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
A peach of a delivery! From around the wicket, lands it outside off, gets the ball to move away after pitching. DK looks to defend it with the angle but gets beaten.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a boundary. The short mid on fielder didn't even move. That's Karunaratne's strength!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Length delivery outside off, shaping away a touch, Silva pokes at it but once again is beaten!
Banged in short! Silva ducks under it to let it sail through!
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Once again Silva has driven straight back, where Abbott makes a half stop.
FOUR! Shot! Full on middle and off, driven straight through mid on for a boundary. Everything was right about this shot! Head was still and just leaned into the drive! That was the shot of the day!
Pitched outside off, DK covers his stumps and opts to leave the ball.
Length delivery angling in from outside off, defended with the angle on the leg side.
Pitched outside off, Karunaratne leaves it.
Comes from around the wicket to mix up things. Fires in a fullish delivery angling in, dug out well by Dimuth.
Outside off and angling away further, punched to point.
Pitched up outside off, Karunaratne defends it off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off, KS pokes at it and gets beaten past the outside edge. That's better from Abbott!
Angling in from around off, defended off the front foot on the off side.
Fuller length delivery outside off, pushed to short mid off.
Full on middle and off, almost a yorker. Silva brings his bat down in time and clips it to square leg.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full outside off, pushed to point.
KYLE ABBOTT to bowl from the other end.
Fullish delivery around off, angling across, defended off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler. Philander mimes of throwing the ball back. Some aggression over there!
Outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery outside off, angling across, Karunaratne looks to push at it but fails to connect.
Full outside off, driven through mid off. There's no mid off in place. Maharaj from short mid off gives it a chase and keeps it down to three.
Outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Length delivery outside off, Silva covers his stumps and presses forward in defence but away movement with extra bounce surprises him and hits him on the glove.

We are back for the second session of day 4. Sri Lanka saw off the first session without any loss of wicket. Now, 5 more sessions to go. Kaushal Silva and Dimuth Karunaratne will look to extend their gritty opening stand as long as possible. VERNON PHILANDER to start off the proceedings. He will look to swing the match in his team's way.
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

South Africa bowled well but cannot say they were menacing. Yes, they were consistent, but plenty of balls were bowled in areas which were easily left alone. They needed to bowl more balls in the area between good and full lengths, as some of those were generating extra bounce. They will look to hit those areas more after Lunch. Join us back at 1610 IST (1040 GMT).

A good session for Sri Lanka. Runs are not that important. But they have negated 14 overs of the minimum 183. Silva got a life but that was a brute of a ball and you get that here and there in your innings. Karunaratne has looked solid from the other end. In short, the Lankan openers have shown in the brief period that they are prepared to survive.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.

Excellent observation from Shaun Pollock on air. He is mentioning about why de Kock ended up dropping that catch an over ago. He keenly observes, stating that de Kock is not exactly ready when the ball is delivered. He is still moving, either to his right and left, and hence, is not exactly still. Good keepers always keep their heads and body still at the time of delivery.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
Down the leg side, short in length, tucked through the vacant leg slip region for a single.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Silva leans and drives it through point for a boundary.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
A sharp bouncer, around off, Dimuth ducks.
Around off, watchfully blocked.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A bouncer on middle, Silva ducks.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Now he looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
Outside off, short in length, Kaushal looks to shoulder arms but the ball jags back in and hits his box.
Outside off, left alone.

EDGED, DROPPED, FOUR! Tough catch. A short ball outside off, Silva rises with the bounce but still ends up fending at it. He takes his right glove off the handle but the ball hits his left glove and goes behind. De Kock dives to his right but is unable to take it. The ball goes to the third man fence.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.
Full on middle, worked straight to mid on.
Full and outside off, Silva pushes this through the covers and sets off for a single. Stephen Cook gets across from point and has a shy at the keeper's but hits the stump microphone instead.
Full and down the leg side, Silva misses his flick.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Change of ends for KYLE ABBOTT.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side.
Down the leg side, left alone.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.
A short ball, worked to long leg for a couple.
FOUR! That is a fine shot. On a good length outside off, Karunaratne punches it through the covers for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, well kept out.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. The fielding side are asking the question. The umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
